info.title: Bearing
info.description: The organisation modeling HTTP API. Every endpoint answers JSON; errors share one envelope. Partners check the capabilities at /meta rather than the build's version.

post.summary: Load the demo organisation, Kestrel Works: about sixty people in four levels, with dotted lines, vacancies, deputies and roles.
post.description: It goes only into an installation without units, all of it or nothing, and only once. The suite realm's alice, bob, carol and dave are in it by address, so their first sign-in links them.

put.summary: Replace the group grants. Members of a granted group come in at once and hold its role while they are in it; somebody in several holds the highest.
put.description: Groups are what the identity provider names at sign-in, so a change to somebody's groups there takes effect at their next sign-in.

default.description: An error, in the one shape every endpoint uses.

get.summary: A person's, a position's or a role's holdings, oldest first, those past and planned too.
get.description: Name personId, positionId or roleId, or several; roleId keeps to the role held directly. asOf, a day written 2006-01-02, keeps to the holdings on that day.

default.description: An error, in the one shape every endpoint uses.

post.summary: Have a person hold a position, or a role directly, from a day, now or planned ahead.
post.description: Left without an end, the holding runs until the position is archived or the person leaves, if either is known, or for good. A position takes as many holders at once as it has seats.

default.description: An error, in the one shape every endpoint uses.
